c1xx.title: 1xx — Informational
c1xx.desc: The request was received and processing continues. Mostly used for WebSocket upgrades (101) and pre-checks (100).

c2xx.title: 2xx — Success
c2xx.desc: The request was processed successfully. Use 200 for a successful GET, 201 for a created resource and 204 for a successful delete.

c3xx.title: 3xx — Redirection
c3xx.desc: Further action is needed to complete the request. Use 301 for permanent moves, 302 for temporary moves and 304 for cache validation.

c4xx.title: 4xx — Client error
c4xx.desc: Something is wrong with the client request. Distinguish unauthenticated (401), forbidden (403), not found (404) and bad request (400).

c5xx.title: 5xx — Server error
c5xx.desc: The server failed to handle the request. Respond quickly to internal errors (500), gateway errors (502/504) and unavailability (503).

tips.title: REST API design tips
tips.desc: Map responses precisely: GET→200, POST→201, DELETE→204, auth→401, permission→403, missing→404, validation→422, rate limit→429, server error→500.
